title: Impeccable: agent design skill with PRODUCT.md, detectors, and 23 slash commands
summary: GitHub repo (~65k stars) shipping one design skill, 23 slash commands, live browser iteration, and 61 deterministic anti-slop detector rules. Evolved from Anthropic frontend-design; init writes PRODUCT.md separately from DESIGN.md.
question_it_answers: How do I install Impeccable to split PRODUCT.md from DESIGN.md and run deterministic slop audits?

claims.text: Install via npx impeccable install then /impeccable init writes PRODUCT.md for audience and voice apart from DESIGN.md visual direction.
claims.subject: design-agent-skills

claims.text: 61 deterministic detector rules flag Inter-everywhere, purple-blue gradients, and card-in-card patterns without calling an LLM.
claims.evidence: Design guidance for AI coding agents: 1 skill, 23 slash commands, live browser iteration, 61 deterministic detector rules.
claims.subject: design-agent-skills

claims.text: npx impeccable detect against https://example.com returned exit 0 with three findings: line-length and low-contrast twice.
claims.evidence: detect https://example.com --json: line-length ~96 chars/line; low-contrast 1.1:1 on Example Domain and body; exit 0
claims.subject: design-agent-skills

claims.text: npx impeccable detect --viewport 390x844 on a default-Claude fixture + blume.codes + frontal.so exited 2 with 20 / 85 / 138 findings. Do not collapse with the earlier desktop URL pass.

claims.text: Official two-URL detect uses waitUntil load. Stock npx on nateherk.com + example.com exited 2 with 15 findings (12+3). Local debug binary: 16 findings (13+3) on the same pair, and 35 findings (32+3) on complete-shelf + example.com. Do not collapse 15 with 16.
claims.evidence: npx 15 (nateherk 12: low-contrast x8 + dark-glow + kicker + overused-font + radial-spotlight-glow). Local shelf 32: undersized-ui-text x11, dark-glow x9, gpt-thin-border-wide-shadow x7 advisory. See impeccable NOTES.
claims.subject: design-agent-skills
